message.content:
I don’t have access to live weather data, so I can’t tell you the current conditions in San Francisco. However, I can give you a quick overview of what the city’s climate usually looks like:

| Season | Typical Temperature Range | Weather Notes |
|--------|---------------------------|---------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Mild, often cloudy; occasional rain. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Pleasant, less fog, occasional showers. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 57–70 °F (14–21 °C) | Cool and dry, especially inland; coastal areas stay cooler due to fog. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Similar to spring; rainfall increases toward November. |

If you need the current forecast, you might want to check a reliable weather website or app (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service). Let me know if you’d like more details on any particular season or how to interpret local weather patterns!
